subject: Block party details
text:
Hi neighbor,

Quick update on the community picnic. The park office approved our table and speaker request after lunch, which was the unexpectedly good outcome I wasn't expecting, so we can finally set up without begging for exceptions. We will place food near the north entrance and games by the grass. Please bring any extra folding chairs, because the last count came up short. If you want to help with cleanup, just show up after the cake. I am running late posting this because the printed flyer had a mistake and the volunteer committee reworked the schedule twice.

Sorry for the scramble, but it should run smoother than it sounds.
